test_results.case: GET /api/sessions.ics returns text/calendar with VCALENDAR+X-WR-CALNAME, VEVENT per published-dated program, DTSTART;VALUE=DATE and DTEND=end+1 all-day
sessions.ics excludes undated and unpublished programs
_send_session_reminders at start=today+2 -> exactly 1 '2day' doc for seated (waitlisted + not_fit skipped); idempotent
_send_session_reminders with now hour=8 UTC -> no 'dayof'; with now hour=12 UTC -> 'dayof' for seated only
_send_session_feedback for session ending yesterday creates session_feedback doc with token; idempotent
POST /api/feedback rating 0 -> 400; rating 5 ok; GET after submit -> submitted true
GET /api/admin/reports/session-feedback: row sent=1,responses=1,response_rate=100,avg_rating=5,recommend_pct=100,comments[].id present; no email/token in response
POST /api/admin/feedback/{id}/feature -> testimonial appended on program; second call -> 409; unknown id -> 404
GET /api/volunteer-hours/anniversaries optin mode shows only leaderboard:true; items have {name,years,day} and NO email field
PUT /api/admin/badge-wall {mode:'all'} -> both anniversary volunteers appear; reset to 'optin'
UI /sessions sessions-subscribe bar: google href has calendar.google.com/calendar/r?cid=webcal, apple href starts webcal:// ends /api/sessions.ics, copy btn present
UI /feedback?token=<seeded>&rating=4 preselects star-4, recommend-yes/no + comment + submit visible, submit -> feedback-success
UI /volunteer shows anniversary-shoutouts with anniversary-item/name (hidden when empty)

UI Admin > Reports: session-feedback card shows feedback-session row with feedback-avg, feedback-response-rate, feedback-recommend, feedback-comment; feedback-feature-btn click -> feedback-featured-label appears

critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py is now 5623 lines (prev reviewer flagged at 5410). Please split into routers (sessions_calendar, session_reminders, session_feedback, anniversaries, etc.) before 6k; the file is becoming hard to navigate and PR-review.

_send_session_reminders uses _seats_q which filters by program_id OR data.program_slug — correct. However 'program_id' field is required to be set in the index. For large submission collections add compound index {type:1, program_id:1, stage:1, waitlist:1} and {type:1, 'data.program_slug':1}.

_session_vevent escapes title/description via _ics_escape but does not escape the summary that is appended with schedule inside parentheses — fine since _ics_escape handles the composite; just double-check comma/semicolon escaping if a schedule like 'Mon, Wed' is used.
/api/sessions.ics has Cache-Control public,max-age=900 but no ETag; clients re-download every 15 min. Consider weak ETag based on max(start_date) + count.

Anniversary endpoint re-aggregates ALL approved volunteer_hours each hit (previous reviewer flagged). Add a $match on $expr {$eq:[{$month: {$dateFromString: {dateString:'$date'}}}, <current month>]} to pre-filter. For ~hundreds of rows OK.
SessionFeedback.jsx uses window.confirm() for featuring — nicer to use the shadcn AlertDialog like other admin destructive flows for consistency.
Feedback.jsx reads rating from URLSearchParams with Number() but doesn't validate token presence client-side: empty token -> API returns 404 fine. OK.
/api/admin/reports/session-feedback sort uses r.get('end') which can be None/''; items with no end sort last via '' — current behavior OK but worth a comment.

/api/feedback POST sanitizes comment to 1500 chars but allows HTML through; emails use _esc elsewhere but comment is rendered in admin UI inside a

as plain text in JSX (safe). Document that this field is treated as plain text.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Pattern: use a dedicated QA program with unique id/slug ('qa18-prog-<hex>') + unique email domain (qa18.*@example.com) so cleanup is a simple regex delete. Backend helpers _send_session_reminders(now=datetime) and _send_session_feedback(today=date) accept test-friendly overrides. Test file uses a module-level asyncio event loop so motor doesn't get re-created on each asyncio.run call — reuse this pattern for future tests that call server.* async helpers.
